research_result.description: Harvest is a time tracking and project management platform providing a comprehensive REST API and an official MCP server for managing timers, projects, tasks, expenses, invoices, and reports.
research_result.credential_requirements: Credentials can be created directly in the Developers section of Harvest ID. Developers can generate a Personal Access Token for custom scripts or register an OAuth 2.0 Application for multi-user integrations. API access is included with all Harvest accounts, including free and trial accounts.

evidence.claim: Harvest V2 API is a REST API supporting CRUD operations across time tracking, expenses, projects, and reporting.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically. You can track time, log expenses, create projects, and more.

evidence.claim: Harvest supports authentication via Personal Access Tokens and OAuth 2.0.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests. There are two options available to you: - A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API. - Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.

evidence.claim: API access is available for all Harvest account tiers, including free and trial accounts.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts) which can be used to manage your Harvest account.

evidence.claim: Harvest provides an official MCP endpoint for connecting AI assistants.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Harvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection lets you work with your Harvest data through an AI assistant, using plain language instead of clicking through the app.
